title: 80% of Medical Bills Have a $1,300 Error Inside
hook: Your hospital quietly billed you for something you never received — and if you don't ask for the itemized list, you'll never know.
angle: Most people blindly pay medical bills that contain systematic errors — there's a simple 5-word fix almost nobody uses, and it's legally required to work.
audience: Anyone who has received a medical bill, been hospitalized, or has health insurance
key_numbers: 80% of medical bills contain at least one error
Hospitals are legally required to send an itemized bill on request
